✓ desktop inline deletion Cancel preserves data; selection changes dismiss confirmation; confirmed exact targets serialize after writes, clear favorites, survive duplicate delivery, roll back failures and reach durable empty state
✓ mode changes retain the same calendar, title, metadata and completion view owners instead of replacing card contents
✓ ordinary native events have month/year headings in both views; favorite remains separate without an empty favorite-only month
✓ rapid alternating modes accept the final tap; reduced-motion and live mid-transition reversal retain event identities, favorite and native divider
✓ search no-results removes empty month headings and restoration preserves events, favorite and split position
✓ forty additional events remain scrollable through the final month in grid/list, selectable at the end and retain favorite and divider
✓ synthetic pending/loaded, missing, global and per-event weather preserve overview/card/detail geometry in narrow/wide collection and feed
✓ overview date and weather share one unclipped row with stable loaded/off geometry in narrow/wide collection and feed
